where: paragraph after Définition 2.7: 'est au plus égal à inf(n,dim(X) - n)'
scan: inf(n,dim(X) - n) (no 2 before dim; checked at 2.5x)
note: h^{pq}(X) ≠ 0 forces p, q ≤ dim X, so q - p = 2q - n ≤ 2 dim X - n (and q - p ≤ p + q = n). With dim(X) - n the Hodge level of the middle cohomology (n = dim X) would be ≤ 0, which fails for a curve of genus ≥ 1 and for V_3(3) (level 1 in the table on p. 60). The TeX keeps the printed reading; the corrected layer already reads 2\dim(X).
